static_traits.name: Lin Wei
static_traits.social_status: Has a close group of friends in the dance team, but has grown distant due to Anxiety about competitions, reducing communication with family and friends
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before; never received psychotherapy or counseling; without significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, acceptable logic, prominent negative tone and Anxiety, candid but guarded about self-disclosure, good cooperation

basic_info.main_problem: I feel overwhelmed and Anxiety because of the competitive dance team's two recent Losing a competition, even though we are still ranked first overall, which makes me believe The whole season is ruined.
basic_info.core_demands: This Anxiety and disappointment affect my enjoyment of dance and overall mental health. I just want to not always feel like a failure, to enjoy dancing again and reduce Anxiety.

special_situations.event: The dance team lost the last two competitions (but still ranks first overall)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot maintain the winning streak, it means the season failed and I failed too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to focus on the positive and practice mindfulness to counter negative emotions

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If we lose once more it proves I disappointed everyone, I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Presets the worst outcome in advance and repeatedly rehearses failure scenes to 'be mentally prepared'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: We will definitely lose again; I will disappoint everyone again.

special_situations.event: During practice or when others mention match performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only a perfect performance and victory show I am good enough; not being perfect equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Raises the standards for herself and intensifies self-criticism, while avoiding talking in depth with others lest she appear weak
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough, I should have done more.

special_situations.event: Realizes the team still ranks first overall but has had recent losses
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive performances do not matter, the recent losses are the real proof
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focusing only on negative outcomes, ignoring or negating positive feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These good results do not count, only losses show we are not good enough.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized by the team and others, not disappointing anyone
core_conflict.fear: Fears being seen as a failure or weak, worried that another loss will be judged by others
defense_goal: Avoids failure by maintaining extremely high standards
Reduces the risk of being judged by avoiding self-exposure

object_relations.self_representation: A failure who disappoints others, not good enough
object_relations.object_representation: Others/the team who hold high expectations of me and may judge me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to talk to friends or family about one's Anxiety and disappointment
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to believe others will not understand her, and will see her as weak (transference: projecting Self-denial onto others' evaluations)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use a vague, cautious tone, avoid discussing feelings in depth, instead describe match results or sources of pressure, reduce self-disclosure.

manifestations: Withdrawing socially due to Anxiety about competitions, finding it hard to discuss disappointment and Anxiety with teammates, friends and family
Choosing not to share inner feelings for fear of being seen as weak
outcomes: Social withdrawal and Increased sense of isolation

manifestations: Views 'the season is ruined' as an overall failure, finding it hard to see existing positivity and value

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing others will see me as weak, therefore avoiding expressing vulnerability
When talking about emotions, focuses more on others' possible views than on one's own experience

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Excessively harsh on one's own performance, believing 'not good enough, should have done more'
Being careful in relationships, reducing self-exposure to avoid being judged

positive_force: Still maintains first place in overall ranking; objectively there are positive results and an ability foundation
Has a group of close teammates who can serve as potential support
Proactively seeks counseling and help; has willingness to change
Has tried focusing on the positive and practicing mindfulness, with some self-help attempts
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking are prominent
Overly concerned about others' evaluations; worries about being seen as weak
Predictive worry about upcoming competitions (jumping to conclusions)
Social avoidance and withdrawal, leading to sleep and Academics affected

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive Anxiety and catastrophic worry before competitions and in related discussions
antecedent: Being reminded of competition performance while practicing
Talking about or thinking of recent losses
target_behavior.core_reason: Tying the pressure of maintaining the winning streak to self-worth (not winning = failure), plus predictive worry about losing again
target_behavior.function: Escapes the threat of failure and being judged, gaining a temporary sense of control and mental preparedness
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired sleep and attention,Low mood,Declining academic performance

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance (avoiding discussing emotions and troubles with teammates, friends, family)
antecedent: When thinking others may see them as weak
Situations needing to share inner feelings or seek support
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being seen as weak or disappointing others, projecting Self-denial onto others' evaluations
target_behavior.function: Avoiding negative evaluation and shame, maintaining Self-protection boundaries
target_behavior.consequence: Social withdrawal and Increased sense of loneliness, Anxiety maintained or even worsened
